messages:
emma: Quick sync — recruitment & handoff for the next DP cohort. Need clarity on commitment language and feedback routing.
raj: Agree. Main ask: how strict is the 2-session minimum? customers push back on calendar load.
emma: We want at least 2 touchpoints: onboarding + working session. Could allow async alternative for session 2.
lina: For evals we need a canonical prompt set. Suggest we include a 'light' and 'deep' bundle for partners.
jonas: From eng ops: can we cap slots per week to 6 partners? GPU capacity + QA windows.
raj: If we cap, we should tier partners (high touch vs async). High touch gets SLA, scheduled sessions.
emma: SLA? maybe only for dedicated partners. For general DP, promise 48h triage on feedback.
jonas: Ops: 48h triage OK, but dev follow-ups may be longer. We'll add 'response' vs 'action' distinctions.
emma: Draft commitment blurb: "Partners commit to 2 feedback activities over 6 weeks; we commit to 48h triage and a product update summary at week 6" — thoughts?
raj: Add opt-out clause for schedule conflicts + ability to do async survey. Also add NDAs, but lightweight.
lina: Also require consent to anonymized excerpts for eval dashboards.
emma: Routing: all feedback -> Zendesk ticket + tag dp-cohort-14 -> auto-summary to product@redwood every Monday.
jonas: Can we have a webhook to send raw logs to partners' S3 for private deployments? Security will require contract.
emma: Good call. For private/dedicated partners include a separate data handoff flow.
raj: Next steps: I'll make a recruitment email draft. @emma can you finalize commitment blurb? @lina prepare prompt bundles.
emma: On it. I'll push draft today; want to run through legal for NDA by EOD.
oncall-bot: Reminder: weekly DP standup Fridays 10am PT. :bell:
